# OCASM depth veil provenance

- Source: https://github.com/OCASM/SotCBloom
- Upstream revision: `17a74e1e9f4b506587ad33b3715445d4103c18a5`
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE`)
- Adapted components: the optional depth-driven bloom source and the artistic
  combine that retains bloom while reducing the original scene contribution.
- The Unity integration, temporal ghost buffer, fixed-resolution blur, and
  shaders are not vendored. The engine uses its own multiscale reconstruction.
